// A distribution of one channel's pixel values. Counts holds the number of
// pixels per bin; the bins uniformly partition Range in order.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Image_histogram)
type ImageHistogram
    implements IValue
{
    Channel: ColorChannel;
    Counts: Array<Integer>;
    Range: NumberInterval;
}
